verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents a first-party `SandboxNetworkPolicy` resource that controls a sandbox's outbound traffic (docs-13), and templates can set a default network policy (docs-23). Egress can also be routed through a customer-controlled proxy, with HTTP and MCP protocol controls layered on top (docs-14, docs-16), so platform engineers get explicit, policy-based egress control. Missing for 10: detail on allow/deny rule granularity (domains, CIDRs, ports) in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the policies are enforced.
